what: float64 value-and-gradient of 0.5 mean over the N^D points of a uniform tensor grid on [-2, 2)^D of (L u - f)^2 for u(x) = sum_h c_h sin(w_h.x + b_h), constant-coefficient L and a separable target (sum of 3 products of cosines); candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.grid_ridge.closed_ridge_grid_loss (exact H x H quadratic form from per-axis Gram matrices; grid never materialised). Per-point methods receive the explicit points and target values.
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every compared method: loss and gradients vs 40-digit mpmath on a row subset (gradients atol 1e-8 / rtol 2e-9, values 1e-9 / 2e-10, scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked; the Gram candidate on the 3^D (2^D when 3^D > 256) sub-grid of the first nodes

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.taylor_structure_aware: Taylor mode in the ridge variable z per hidden unit, combined with exact operator-symbol amplitudes (exploits the one-layer ridge structure)
tiers.taylor_network_level: network-level higher-order AD of u(x): JAX Taylor mode (jet) and collapsed Taylor mode along exact polarization directions (run when <= 400 directions), nested forward-mode AD per monomial (run when the monomial work is bounded), folx forward Laplacian (Delta to Delta^3 only)
tiers.omnibias_per_point_closed_form: per-point closed forms on the explicit grid points: the shipped XLA module, the shipped fused GPU kernels and the XLA closed-form programs

roles.held_out: cells and seed not used for any tuning

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
